method: skill-creator scripts.run_eval, model claude-opus-5-5, 3 runs per query, threshold 0.5
note: Parallel runs (--num-workers 10) share one .claude/commands folder, so each claude -p sees ~10 copies of the skill under different names and often picks another worker's copy; that scored 5/10 for both descriptions. Sequential runs (--num-workers 1) are the valid measurement.
